description: This file defines the NationalityAPI class, which provides CRUD API endpoints for managing nationality data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing nationalities, along with related validation rules and integration with the service layer.

classes.name: NationalityAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for Nationality entities, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and listing nationalities, along with validation rules and dependency management.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single nationality by its ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all nationalities with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new nationality record based on request data.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Saves or updates a Nationality entity with provided name.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing nationality identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more nationalities based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single nationality.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing nationalities, including sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new nationality.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an existing nationality.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting nationalities.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rule for the 'name' parameter with optional uniqueness check.
